model.name: YuE 7B + 1B
model.description: YuE is a two stage open music generation model. A 7B segment planner writes the song from lyrics and style tags, then a 1B model renders the vocal and instrumental tracks with the xcodec neural audio codec.
model.selector_help: Long form songs from lyrics (prompt) plus genre and mood tags (alt prompt). The download is about 18 GB in two stages plus the codec. On GPUs with less than 12 GB of VRAM the 7B planner runs partially on system memory, so the first segment takes noticeably longer.

prompt:
[Verse]
Morning light filters through the pines
Every quiet road is yours and mine
[Chorus]
Softly the whole world starts to breathe
Stay for one more song with me
[Outro]
The kettle sings, the window glows
We take the long way home
alt_prompt: pop, dreamy, warm vocal, female, nostalgic
